title: Refunds for damaged parcels
content: If a parcel arrives damaged in transit the customer gets a full refund of the order amount. Refunds over 5000 rupees need a team lead to approve them. The refund reaches the original payment method in five business days.

title: Late deliveries
content: Orders that arrive more than three days after the promised date earn a shipping credit. Late delivery alone does not qualify for a refund of the goods.

title: Returns window
content: Unused items can be returned within 30 days of delivery. The customer books a pickup and the refund is issued after the warehouse inspects the item.

title: Changing the delivery address
content: The delivery address can be changed until the order is packed. After it ships, the courier must be contacted to reroute the parcel.

title: Cancelling an order
content: An order can be cancelled for free before it ships. Cancelled prepaid orders are refunded automatically within two days.

title: Gold membership
content: Gold members get free express shipping, priority support and early access to sales. Membership renews every year unless cancelled.

title: Payment failures
content: If a payment fails but money left the account, the bank reverses it within seven days. Support cannot speed up a bank reversal.

title: Warranty claims
content: Electronics carry a one year manufacturer warranty. Claims go to the brand service centre with the invoice and serial number.
